== English Endor comparison ==
The published 2023 wording refers to Janse just targeting a character with the A280 Sharpshooter Rifle. The Players Committee described the update as clarifying intended play. The weapon destiny bonus, Sorry About The Mess clause, lore, icon and printed values agree across the two faces.
